dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, crenulated perimeters. There is a distinct, sharp gradient transition from the dark-charcoal background pixels to a light-grey ring, which surrounds a localized interior core of mid-tone grey pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters located primarily in the gaps between macro-annuli. These clusters lack an internal gradient and are concentrated most densely on the posterior dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form a fixed obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary chain of smaller, high-intensity blobs forms a curvilinear geometric relationship following the lateral curvature toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced zone of high-intensity white pixel saturation at the posterior terminus of the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
